name: Thyme and Again Farmstall
description_short: Beloved N2 farmstall serving fresh bakes, farm-style breakfasts, and local produce in a country garden setting.
description_long:
A Garden Route institution, Thyme and Again sits roadside on the N2 just outside Plettenberg Bay, drawing travellers and locals alike with its honest farmstall charm. The bakery counter heaves with fresh breads, scones, and pastries baked daily, while the deli stocks local cheeses, preserves, and handmade goods. Settle in the garden under the trees for a proper farm-style breakfast or light lunch – think generous omelettes, wholesome sandwiches, and homemade cakes with proper coffee.

The atmosphere is relaxed and unpretentious, with families spreading out on the lawn and road-trippers breaking their journey over a toasted sandwich and slice of melktert. It's the kind of place where you pop in for a quick coffee and end up browsing the shop for half an hour, loading up on biltong, rusks, and gifts to take home. A reliable, welcoming stop that captures the spirit of country hospitality on the Garden Route.
